name: outlift
description: Outlift is a workout planning and logging app for personal trainers and their trainees. From ChatGPT you can see today's plan, log sets, swap an exercise you cannot do, review progress and weigh-ins, or, as a trainer, build training days and schedules.

interface.longDescription: Outlift is a workout planning and logging app for personal trainers and their trainees. This plugin connects ChatGPT to your Outlift account, so you can manage training by chatting. Trainees see today's or this week's plan, log sets, reps, weight and time as they train, swap a planned exercise for a similar one, check what they lifted last time, record their weekly body weight and review their progress. Trainers build training days (including supersets) from the exercise library, add custom exercises with photos and translations, put training days on their trainees' weeks, follow their stats and log workouts on a trainee's behalf. Exercises are always identified by id, so names work in Polish and English. Outlift only touches the account you connect. Reading works with the basic connection; changing anything needs you to allow write access when you connect. It supports training, it does not give medical advice.
defaultPrompt: What's on my Outlift plan this week?
I can't do an exercise today, swap it for a similar one.

positive.description: Show the weekly training plan (signed in as the demo trainee).
positive.prompt: What's on my Outlift training plan this week?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the days of the week that have a training day, with each day's exercises, sets and reps.

positive.description: Log today's planned workout using the exercise id from the plan (demo trainee).
positive.prompt: Log today's workout in Outlift: RDL 3 sets of 8 at 60 kg.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads today's planned workout (Nogi) to get the RDL exerciseId, saves 3 sets of 8 reps at 60 kg with that id, and confirms what was recorded and that the other planned exercises are still open.

positive.description: Swap a planned exercise for a similar one and log it (demo trainee).
positive.prompt: I can't do the leg press today in Outlift. Swap it for something similar and log 3 sets of 10 at 80 kg.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the planned leg press in today's workout, suggests similar exercises that work the same muscles, and logs the chosen one with the leg press as the exercise it replaces, so it keeps the planned sets and reps. Confirms the swap.

positive.description: Create a training day template from library exercises (demo trainer).
positive.prompt: In Outlift, create a training day called Review Upper with bench press 4x8 and pull-ups 3x10.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the exercises in the library and creates the Review Upper training day with both exercises in order, confirming the result.

positive.description: Review progress and body weight over the last weeks (demo trainee).
positive.prompt: How is my training going in Outlift over the last month, and what is my weight trend?
positive.expected_behavior: Summarizes the last weeks of training (sessions done, how performance is trending) and the recent weekly weigh-ins; if there are no weigh-ins yet it says so instead of inventing numbers.

negative.description: Do not trigger for general fitness or nutrition advice.
negative.prompt: How much protein should I eat per day to build muscle?

negative.description: Do not trigger for booking classes or appointments.
negative.prompt: Book me a spin class at my gym tomorrow at 6 pm.

negative.description: Do not trigger for other fitness services or medical questions.
negative.prompt: My knee hurts after squats, what injury could it be?

review.commerce_description: Outlift does not sell products or process payments through this plugin.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: plans, workout logging with exercise swaps, progress and weigh-ins, and training planning for trainers.

pl-PL.subtitle: Plany i zapis treningów
pl-PL.description: Outlift to aplikacja do planowania i zapisywania treningów dla trenerów personalnych i ich podopiecznych. Ta wtyczka łączy ChatGPT z Twoim kontem w Outlift, więc treningiem zarządzasz w rozmowie. Podopieczni widzą dzisiejszy lub tygodniowy plan, zapisują serie, powtórzenia, ciężar i czas w trakcie treningu, zamieniają zaplanowane ćwiczenie na podobne, sprawdzają, z czym trenowali ostatnio, zapisują tygodniową wagę i oceniają postępy. Trenerzy tworzą dni treningowe (także superserie) z biblioteki ćwiczeń, dodają własne ćwiczenia ze zdjęciami i tłumaczeniami, układają dni treningowe w tygodniu podopiecznych, śledzą ich statystyki i zapisują treningi w ich imieniu. Ćwiczenia są zawsze rozpoznawane po identyfikatorze, więc nazwy działają po polsku i po angielsku. Outlift działa tylko na koncie, które połączysz. Odczyt działa z podstawowym połączeniem; zmiana czegokolwiek wymaga zgody na zapis przy łączeniu. To wsparcie treningowe, nie porada medyczna.
